summary: Standalone execution nodes outside the controller cluster add job capacity; control nodes submit work to them through Receptor and they register as type execution. Their time zone must match settings.TIME_ZONE (default UTC) because fact caching compares file times. Hop nodes, type hop, relay traffic to unreachable networks; AAP on AWS includes two by default. Add them under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instances.
questions: How do I add an execution node to operator-based AAP?
Why must execution node time zone match controller?
Does AAP on AWS include hop nodes?

answer_card.title: Execution and hop nodes on operator-based AAP
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Execution node:** outside the Kubernetes cluster, registered as type `execution`; only runs jobs. Control nodes submit work to it through Receptor.
- **Hop node:** outside the cluster, type `hop`; only relays traffic to nodes in other or stricter networks. AAP on AWS includes two by default.
- Add either under **Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instances > Add instance**.

The execution node's system time zone must match `settings.TIME_ZONE` (default UTC), because fact caching compares file modification times.
